case_evidence.iff-reverse: A finite POVM may fail to distinguish even different output states, so closeness of this measurement law cannot recover an operator-norm bound on U-V. No such reverse implication occurs in any of the three proof steps.
case_evidence.empty: A density operator has nonnegative eigenvalues summing to1, as used in2.1, so the underlying space is nonzero. A finite POVM summing to its identity cannot have an empty outcome family on that space.
case_evidence.endpoints: U and V are fixed finite-dimensional unitaries and the proof compares their output density operators directly. There is no time/path/interval parameter requiring endpoint transport or limiting values.
